decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the added panel power-button connector, its PWRON source, and the expanded panel-input coverage.
A same-message MODIFY already moves the power-button connector from the power board to the main board, records the J_PWR_SIG pin 4 source, and updates the scope context.
The new main-board panel button connector does not change any sensor-board input connector, sensor output connector, or sensor-board connector count.
The source reuses the existing PWRON signal on J_PWR_SIG pin 4 without changing the interboard connector type, pinout, or matching-numbering policy.
Adding a connector that taps the existing PWRON control line does not alter monitored rails, monitor placement, current coverage, or monitor-channel allocation.
The panel power-button connector is unrelated to the CHGLED connector, charge-status indication, and associated resistor or population settings.
The source adds a control-line tap but leaves the board-chain order, power connectors, distributed rails, and forwarding behavior unchanged.
The new panel button connector does not change standalone USB activation, the LDO, its capacity, or the powered 3.3V scope.
Tapping the existing PWRON line does not change the Schottky OR-ing method, power sources, source-selection behavior, or diode requirement.
The panel power-button connector does not affect LED supply voltage, power switching, level shifting, power-control separation, or LED selection.
The connector taps the existing hardware PWRON line at J_PWR_SIG pin 4 and does not establish or change an ESP32 GPIO assignment.
Relocating the panel power-button connector to the main board does not change the battery connector, its pinout, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
